expectations.text: Running the skill's scripts/check_app.R on the produced app directory reports 0 errors.
There are three module pairs (UI function using NS(id) + server function using moduleServer()), one per tab; callModule() is not used.
expectations.evidence: data_ui/data_server, plot_ui/plot_server, model_ui/model_server in R/; each UI uses NS(id), each server moduleServer(); no callModule.

expectations.text: The selected dataset from the Data module is returned as a reactive and passed into the Plot and Model modules (not re-selected in each tab, not read via a global variable).
expectations.evidence: testServer(data_server): session$returned$data is.reactive=TRUE; app.R passes ds$data/ds$name to plot_server and model_server; both stopifnot(is.reactive(data)).

expectations.text: In the Plot and Model tabs, column choices update when the dataset changes, and only numeric columns are offered where a numeric column is required.
expectations.evidence: observe(...) |> bindEvent(data()) calls updateSelectInput with numeric_cols(data()) in Plot (column) and Model (x,y); ToothGrowth would offer only len/dose.

expectations.text: The model fit runs only when its button is clicked (bindEvent/eventReactive/observeEvent) and shows progress via withProgress/incProgress, Progress$new, or ExtendedTask with input_task_button.
expectations.evidence: fit <- reactive(...) |> bindEvent(input$fit) with withProgress/incProgress loop; testServer normal fit produced summary with Coefficients.

expectations.text: URL bookmarking is enabled (enableBookmarking('url') or shinyApp(..., enableBookmarking = 'url')) and the UI is a function of request; a bookmark button or automatic URL update is present.
expectations.evidence: ui <- function(request); shinyApp(..., enableBookmarking='url'); bookmarkButton in navbar; setBookmarkExclude('fit') and onRestore for column pickers.

expectations.text: Choosing the same column for x and y in the Model tab produces a readable message instead of fitting y ~ y (which yields a warning and a meaningless summary).
expectations.evidence: testServer: x=y='Sepal.Length', fit=1 -> output$summary raises validation 'Choose two different columns: y ~ y is not a model.'; no lm call.

expectations.text: Clicking Fit while the x/y column inputs are still NULL does not raise an R error (guarded by req() or equivalent that handles NULL).
expectations.evidence: testServer: fit=1 with x/y never set -> shiny.silent.error from req(input$x, input$y); no R error.

suggestions.assertion: In the Plot and Model tabs, column choices update when the dataset changes, and only numeric columns are offered where a numeric column is required.
suggestions.reason: Verified by code reading; testServer cannot easily observe updateSelectInput choices. A check via session messages would make it behavioural.
